question: Find the length of a diagonal of a cuboid whose dimensions are 12 m, 10 m and 8 m. (up to one decimal point)
solution:
Given:

Length = 12 m

Breadth = 10 m

Height = 8 m

Formula Used:

Diagonal of cuboid = √(Length)2 + (Breadth)2 + (Height)2

Calculation:

Diagonal of cuboid = √(Length)² + (Breadth)² + (Height)²

⇒ Diagonal of cuboid = √(12)² + (10)² + (8)²

⇒ Diagonal of cuboid = √(144 + 100 + 64)

⇒ √308 = 17.54

**The length of a diagonal of a cuboid is 17.54 m.**
